details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: "auth users" authorization bypass on entries containing
     a space
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-70463.patch: parse the "auth users" value with
       conf_strtok() in auth_server(), so the documented leading-comma form
       splits on commas alone and an "@Group Name:deny" entry is no longer
       torn in two -- discarding the deny rule and creating an implicit allow
       rule from its first word; import conf_strtok() into util.c, which this
       version does not yet carry; document the leading-comma form in
       rsyncd.conf.yo and in the pre-generated rsyncd.conf.5 (this tree ships
       no yodl2man, so only the .5 is installed), without which an admin is
       never told the form that activates the fix; and add
       testsuite/cve-2026-70463.test
     - CVE-2026-70463
   * SECURITY UPDATE: daemon filter-merge bypass of the module filter list
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-53786.patch: in parse_filter_file(), strip the
       module_dir prefix that parse_merge_name() prepended before checking a
       client-supplied --filter merge file against daemon_filter_list, so the
       anchored module-relative daemon rule can match; the strip is
       conditional on the prefix really being present so the daemon's own
       "include from" / "exclude from" and get_cvs_excludes() paths are not
       truncated; upstream's early return on a daemon-filter hit is
       deliberately not taken, since without v3.5.0's
       daemon_config_filter_file exemption it would silently drop the
       operator's own "include from" / "exclude from" rules and, without
       v3.5.0's name+errno suppression, would leave hidden merge files
       silent while missing ones stay fatal; add
       testsuite/cve-2026-53786.test
     - CVE-2026-53786
   * SECURITY UPDATE: daemon NULL dereference on a non-directory first
     file-list entry
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-70459.patch: reject a "." or "/." transfer-root
       entry whose mode is not a directory in recv_file_entry(), and require
       dir_flist to actually hold an entry in recv_file_list() before trusting
       parent_ndx 0, closing the wild-pointer read that crashes the
       per-connection daemon child
     - CVE-2026-70459
   * SECURITY UPDATE: --delete scope widening via implied-parent
     reclassification
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-53789.patch: add is_implied_parent_dir() to
       exclude.c and use it in recv_file_entry() to force an implied parent
       back to the honest XMIT_TOP_DIR | XMIT_NO_CONTENT_DIR encoding, on both
       the protocol >= 30 and the legacy protocol < 30 paths, so it lands in
       FLAG_IMPLIED_DIR and delete_in_dir() cannot sweep pre-existing siblings
       outside the intended destination subtree
     - debian/patches/CVE-2022-29154-2.patch: drop the trailing slash in
       add_implied_include(), completing the upstream CVE-2022-29154 series
       this branch carries, so a "src/dir/" argument seeds the requested leaf
       as a plain include rule instead of a FILTRULE_DIRECTORY one; without it
       is_implied_parent_dir() would classify the explicitly requested
       directory as an implied parent and --delete would stop pruning it
     - CVE-2026-53789
